content.comment_body: Hello, I want to connect my [product_name] to Home Assistant through Modbus. I prefer using LAd programming, but Network Project mode doesn't support it. In Diagram mode, I am unable to link to Home Assistant via Modbus. Kind regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user aims to connect a [product_name] to Home Assistant using Modbus. They note a limitation in the [product_name] programming software: LAd programming is not available in Network Project mode, and Diagram mode lacks Modbus connectivity with Home Assistant. This presents a challenge for those requiring both LAd programming and integration via Modbus.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to work with LAd programming while maintaining Modbus connectivity to Home Assistant within the [product_name] programming environment.
